verdicts.reason: A: the enlarged headline spills out of the image band and "the limit" sits right on the busy striped building photo. That is a clear text-on-busy-image collision, and the type also crowds the top while the bottom third of the canvas is empty. B: the headline stays clear of the photo, but it re-wraps with "us." orphaned on its own line. The original is still a thin strip in the middle of the canvas with dead space above and below, so the design was shrunk onto the new size, not rearranged for it. Even so, B is the less broken of the two.
